Subject: Two-track technical deep dive + procurement intake: proposed next steps

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our discovery: ClarityAI is evaluating inference runtimes for production ML features (low-latency scoring + batch offline embeddings). You flagged two parallel needs that make the most sense for next-phase work:

- 1) Deep technical walk: architecture, SSO/SSO mapping, perf expectations on 16–128 token windows, and integration points for prefix caching. We'll demo a sandbox run and share KV/cache behavior.
- 2) Procurement + security intake: SOC2 evidence, data retention, contractual questions and required PO/DocuSign cadence.

Proposal: run a two-track session next week — first 45m focused on platform integration and run-time behavior (engineering audience), then 30m with procurement/security to confirm evidence path and purchasing milestones. Two practical options:

Option A — Tue 11/3 10:00–11:15 PT (deep dive + procurement overlap 10:45–11:15)
Option B — Thu 11/5 13:00–14:15 PT (deep dive + procurement overlap 13:45–14:15)

Can you confirm which slot works for your team? Also please flag who from your side should join each track (engineering vs procurement/security). I’ll loop in our security and finance leads once we lock a time.

I attached a short procurement checklist and our SOC2 summary so your procurement/security team can preview before the intake call.

Thanks —
Neha
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (1 page summary), procurement_checklist_v1.xlsx (template)
